title: SpendVeto policy v1
description: One file that states how much an AI agent may spend, where, and when a human must approve, across model tokens, stablecoins (x402), cards, bank payouts and regional payment rails. Every key is optional; an omitted key falls back to the documented default. Keys starting with $ or x- are reserved for comments and extensions and are never interpreted.

maxPerCallUSD.description: Largest single x402 / tool payment an agent may make. Default 0.05.

maxPerHourUSD.description: Rolling-hour spend cap per wallet, counting open upto and auth-capture holds. Default 0.2.

maxCallsPerHour.description: Rolling-hour call-count cap per wallet. Default 10.

requireApprovalAboveUSD.description: Payments above this need a human approval first. Default 0.015.

approversRequired.description: Distinct human approvals needed before an approval lands (a deny is always final). Default 1.

requireWorldIdForApproval.description: Require a World ID proof of personhood on every approval. Default false.

anomaly.description: Runaway-loop auto-freeze: this many payment attempts inside the window freezes the wallet.

allowedChains.description: Chain ids agents may settle on (see GET /api/chains). Omit to allow every registered chain.

allowedPayees.description: Recipient addresses or ENS names external tools may pay. Omit or leave empty to allow any.

allowedHoursUTC.description: UTC window in which spending is allowed; wrap-around windows (22 to 6) are supported.

categoryCapsUSD.description: Rolling-hour cap per spend category (engineering, content, card, payout, llm, ...).

alertWebhookUrl.description: Where freeze, block and approval alerts are POSTed.

alertSigningSecret.description: HMAC secret for the X-SpendVeto-Signature header on alerts.

billingWebhookUrl.description: Where one normalized usage event per settlement is POSTed.

llm.description: The LLM spend guard in front of Claude Code, Codex and the OpenAI / Anthropic SDKs.

mode.description: observe decides and records but never blocks. Default enforce.

sessionBudgetUSD.description: Per Claude Code session; null turns it off. Default null.

maxRequestUSD.description: Worst-case estimate allowed for one request. Default 5.

outputEstimateCapTokens.description: Output tokens reserved per request when the client asks for more. Default 16000.

approvalAboveUSD.description: Pause requests estimated above this for a human; null turns it off. Default null.

loop.description: Freeze an agent that repeats the same successful tool call and result.

allowedModels.description: Only these models; null allows any. Default null.

requireAgentToken.description: Refuse requests without a registered agent's tg_ token. Default false.

identityFrom.description: Identify agents by label/token (local) or by the API key they send (credential). Default local.

passthroughUnknown.description: Forward endpoints the guard cannot meter. Default false (refused with 501).

prices.description: Per-model price overrides in USD per million tokens.

unknownModelRates.description: Price for models no price sheet knows, per provider. Default: each provider's flagship rate.

tagBudgets.description: Budgets on a tag across every agent carrying it, keyed team=search or customer=cus_123.

cards.description: Real-time authorization decisions for agent cards (Stripe Issuing, Lithic).

allowedMccs.description: Only these merchant categories; null allows any not blocked.

payouts.description: Governed fiat payouts: Stripe, RazorpayX (UPI/IMPS/NEFT/RTGS), PayPal, Modern Treasury (ACH/RTP/wire).

allowedPayees.description: Payees that skip the new-payee approval.

fxRates.description: Operator-declared USD per unit of each currency, e.g. INR 0.012. SpendVeto never guesses a rate.

approvalTimeoutSeconds.description: Default 86400; an unanswered approval fails closed.

rebilling.description: Customer-tagged model spend to Stripe Billing meter events at a markup.

finops.description: Billing account labels on the FOCUS export.

authCapture.description: Buyer-side rules for the x402 auth-capture escrow scheme.

attestations.description: Governed-spend attestations: proof for a seller that a payment passed this policy.

ttlSeconds.description: Lifetime of a minted attestation. Default 300.

trustedIssuers.description: Other SpendVeto issuers whose attestations this instance accepts as a seller.

requireOnCatalog.description: Refuse catalog payments that carry no valid attestation. Default false.

trustedPublishers.description: Publishers whose signed feeds may be imported. Empty means none (fail closed).

importedAction.description: What an imported block does: refuse (deny) or ask a human (review). Default deny.

publisherName.description: Name on this instance's published feed.

upi.description: India UPI AutoPay mandates (amounts in INR).

eu.description: EU SEPA Direct Debit under PSD2 (amounts in EUR).

br.description: Brazil Pix and Pix Automatico (amounts in BRL).

us.description: US ACH debits under Nacha and Reg E (amounts in USD).
